Key finding: PR #602's title and commit history (`fix: reconstruct PROGRESS.md correctly`, `fix: remove duplicate PROGRESS.md header line from reconstruction`) claim this round finally fixes PROGRESS.md's reconstruction, but the diff itself still misattributes content between task sections:

- New "Remaining" items about a curl/report-id example and STRICT_TENANT_ISOLATION get appended under the *Product chain-selector* task's (PR #607) Remaining header, even though that content clearly belongs to a different task (`reporting-api-gateway--external-ai-scope`), whose own header exists earlier with an empty body.
- The tail of the diff appends `- [ ] None -- task complete` and `- [ ] Fresh supervisor audit of PR #607, then merge (not by this session).` directly under the *current* task's (`re-audit-owner-engine`) `## Completed` header with no `## Remaining` header separating them — and PR #607 has nothing to do with that task.

The new audit report (`ai-os/audits/owner_engine_reaudit_2026-07-27.md`) and the `ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml` entry are solid and well-evidenced on their own; the problem is specifically that this PR's stated purpose — a clean PROGRESS.md reconstruction — isn't actually achieved.
